intent: Use the same model label on separately bounded incident and later-analysis boxes. Leave identity and memory connectors absent despite the shared label.
source:
**Frame:** Two separate boxes share the model label `GPT-5.6 SOL`: one contains minority incident trajectories; the other contains later analysis runs. No arrow of memory or identity connects them.

**Caption:**
> THE SAME MODEL APPEARS ON BOTH SIDES OF THE REVIEW.
>
> NOT THE SAME RUN. NOT THE SAME MEMORY.

**Provenance:** `documented` + `inferred` — model-level relationship sourced; non-identity boundary explicit.
title: The same model label does not establish identity or memory
